Hi Alice —

Great to meet you on the call earlier. Per our discussion, I put together a lightweight starter canvas that stitches our mutual milestones (trial goals, acceptance criteria, stakeholders, and success metrics) and a Week 0 agenda we can run with your team. The idea is to keep the first two weeks focused on a small, measurable test (1–2 endpoints, real sample traffic, smoke tests) so we can validate performance and data controls quickly.

Attached: acme-trial-accel-canvas.gdoc (live draft), week0-agenda.gslides, 2slide-summary.pdf

Would you be available for a 60-min Week 0 workshop next Tuesday 10/12 or Wednesday 10/13? Proposed agenda in the Week0 deck: introductions, success metrics alignment, technical readiness checklist, test plan + owners, and next steps.

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm preferred workshop date/time (10/12 or 10/13)
- Rahul and your infra lead share a short list of validation data and access constraints (VPN/KMS)
- We finalize owners in the starter canvas before the workshop

Happy to iterate on the doc; I shared edit access on the link (below) so you can add any stakeholders.

Link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c-acme-trial-canvas

Thanks,
Kimberly Park

Looping in a couple of technical owners and adding a short checklist to the canvas.

Kimberly — I added a 5-row technical readiness checklist to the Week0 deck (network, creds, sample payloads, perf target, observability hook). Alice — Rahul, if you can drop the sanitized sample payloads into the shared Drive folder before EOD 10/11, we'll run a quick pre-check on our side so the workshop hits the ground running.

Small note on the acceptance gating: I drafted three concrete checks in the canvas:
- Functional: reproduce 95% of baseline responses for the 10 seed prompts
- Performance: median p99 latency < 350ms on test load
- Security: no sensitive fields returned; audit log generation enabled for all requests

I also added owners (Redwood SRE: Jasmine Liu; Customer infra: Rahul Singh) and an action item column. If you prefer a separate Acceptance Criteria doc I can spawn one, but keeping it in the canvas keeps traces together.
